mapper.update: UPDATE payment_payee_review SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},updated_at=#{updatedAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},checked_at=#{checkedAt},valid_until=#{validUntil},consumed_authorization_id=#{consumedAuthorizationId},issue=#{issue},state_json=#{stateJson} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_payee_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM payment_payee_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND original_authorization_id=#{originalAuthorizationId} AND requested_by=#{finance} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM payment_payee_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND consumed_authorization_id=#{authorizationId}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM payment_payee_review q LEFT JOIN payment_authorization auth ON auth.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND auth.id=q.original_authorization_id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND a.id=auth.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=auth.round_no WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
